info.summary: Only routes that are live today are listed. Planned capabilities are not.
info.description: x402 payment-gated task execution operated by UnyKorn LLC (Wyoming). Unpaid requests receive HTTP 402 with payment requirements; a request carrying a valid X-PAYMENT authorization is settled, executed once, and answered with a rail receipt. Authorized does not mean universally right. Refused does not mean universally wrong. Each receipt reports an outcome under a declared scope, evidence state, policy version, and time.

XPayment.name: X-PAYMENT
XPayment.description: x402 v2 payment payload (base64 JSON). Base lane: {x402Version:2, scheme:'exact', network:'eip155:8453', payload:{signature, authorization:{from,to,value,validAfter,validBefore,nonce}}} — an EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization for USDC. Omit to receive the 402 challenge.

PaymentRequired.description: Payment requirements. `accepts[]` lists payable lanes with server-side price, asset, network and payTo. The server never reads a price from the payer.

PaidResult.description: Task output plus `receipt` {receipt_id, task, rail, tx_hash, amount_usd, paid, settled_by, at}.

Replay.description: tx_hash_already_consumed — each payment proof buys exactly one execution.

LaneUnavailable.description: No lane can settle; no price is quoted; nothing is charged.
